column1: # Curated FlorML place-name aliases (French and English, historical names) -> ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 or GeoNames continent code.
# Keys are matched after flopo2.geo.gazetteer.normalize_name (case-fold, strip diacritics, hyphen/apostrophe spacing, trailing '.').
# English GeoNames country names (countries.tsv name_en) are matched automatically and need no row here.
# Historical names map to the present-day country whose territory they denote; ambiguous names (Rhodesie, Korea, Indes, Arabie, New Guinea, Indochina) are deliberately absent and stay local features.
